ev: DESCRIBES the built/unbuilt split, checked against the tree: crates/vibe-spec/src/link_table.rs carries the graph and a deterministic dump; no persisted on-disk format and no structural consumer exist anywhere in crates/ — the second half of the sentence is an absence, and the absence measures.

DESCRIBES the standing alternative, also checked: `expand_embeds` is called by `render_static` in crates/vibe-workspace/src/boot_artifacts.rs, so `#embed spec://…` does resolve and splice at compile time today, which is the reason the tables are not on the critical path.

The ruling it records is the owner's, 2026-07-29, and it was carried by BACKLOG.md B-001 until this commit moved it here. The move is the point: a reader of the open question could not previously learn why the item was not being worked on.

PRESCRIBES a promotion condition; coherent, and both of its referents resolve — `@spec://` pointers in the boot lane exist and are measurable, and §13's structural loader is a named section of this same document.

The clause is deliberately falsifiable in the direction that matters: it names what would make the deferral wrong, so the decision cannot quietly become permanent by nobody revisiting it. Nothing in the tree fires either condition today — the structural mode is unimplemented and no reader-cost measurement exists (the standing «замеров нет» answer).
